thread:
eli: Quick sketch: a right-hand 'spotlight' drawer for first-run that shows a 3-step checklist, tiny thumbcards for sample apps, and a single context-aware CTA. It slides over the canvas but doesn't block it. Hoping to keep momentum without losing context. Thoughts? :sparkles:

samir: I like the non-modal approach. One catch: don't steal focus on open. Let keyboard users tab into it. If someone clicks 'Guide me' then trap focus.

anya: For the thumbcards: mini SVG + 1-line value prop, then a subtle 'Preview' link that opens a read-only preview in a new panel. Avoid heavy images.

eli: Copy idea: instead of 'Import' use 'Create demo workspace' and small helper copy: 'Sandbox environment — no billing unless you add resources'. Less scary than 'import'.

qa-bot: Accessibility checklist to include in PR: 1) focus order and visible focus indicator, 2) aria-live announcements for step progression, 3) reduced-motion respect for the slide-in, 4) 4.5:1 contrast for captions.

samir: Perf note: preload only metadata (title, short blurb, tiny svg). Defer assets until user starts import. Use optimistic UI with spinner + background queue and show inline retry if it fails.

anya: Microcopy tweaks: header 'Quick start  (5 mins)' and CTA labels that are specific, e.g. 'Try FinOps demo' rather than generic 'Start'. Also add a tiny 'skip tutorial' link for experienced users.

eli: Discoverability idea: collapsed state shows a small pill 'Welcome — 3 steps' with a 5s pulse on first visit. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. We'll only send a 'spotlight_pulse_shown' telemetry event after user consents.

samir: Instrumentation: sample-preview clicks, preview->create conversion, create failures, time-to-first-API-call. Also include error codes for failures.

anya: For screen readers, add aria-label to the drawer toggle and aria-describedby on the preview button explaining it won't spin up billable resources. Also announce 'Demo workspace ready' via aria-live polite when provisioning completes.

eli: Plan: I'll prototype the thumbcards and pulse. @anya can write the copy strings and accessibility notes. @samir will handle import queue retries. We'll ship behind a feature flag and run an A/B comparing pulse vs no-pulse.

qa-bot: Add these a11y tests to the PR template: keyboard walkthrough, screen reader narration, reduced-motion toggle check, high-contrast mode, and live-provision announcement verification.

eli: Thanks team — I'll post the prototype link in #design and attach quick test instructions. :rocket:
